original_context: Roselyn does not educate others on sustainability.
Roselyn does not promote eco-friendly practices.
Roselyn does not specialize in renewable energy.
If someone advocates for conservation, they may not necessarily educate others on sustainability, and vice versa.
Everyone who works with their hands either has trade skills or can troubleshoot equipment (or both).
If Roselyn either implements green technologies or advocates for conservation (but not both), then she promotes eco-friendly practices.
If Roselyn either designs sustainable solutions or implements green technologies (but not both), then she helps reduce the carbon footprint.
If Roselyn has trade skills, then she is either a licensed electrician or specializes in renewable energy (but not both).
For all humans, if someone is a licensed electrician, then they can install energy-efficient systems and help reduce the carbon footprint.
